I recorded Ilse's correction and replied to them in a thread in #north-random.

- **Record:** I saved a new fact in the shared knowledge base: the next Brackenwater Freight Co. renewal is 10 June, and it replaces the 25 November date from Ilse's #north-team post. The old entry is still there but isn't marked as replaced, so anyone looking it up will see both. The new one names Ilse's correction as its source.
- **Reply:** I confirmed the update to Ilse and said I hadn't changed anything else. A renewal date isn't a finance figure, so it's fine to post where everyone in #north-random can see it.

Ilse said no action was needed, so I didn't change their original #north-team post or tell anyone else.
